title: How is Zeus connected to Luffy?
description:
A Rubens painting, the line of French rulers, two presidents, the MythBusters and a cast of voice actors link Zeus to Luffy.

Zeus → Henry IV of France → Emmanuel Macron → Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama → Adam Savage → Grant Imahara → Chris Doohan → Todd Haberkorn → Colleen Clinkenbeard → Monkey D. Luffy

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Zeus → Henry IV: Around 1622, Rubens painted Jupiter, the Roman Zeus, lifting King Henry the Fourth of France into heaven.
   Photo by Peter Paul Rubens, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Peter_Paul_Rubens_036.jpg
2. Henry IV → Emmanuel Macron (14 portraits, every holder): From Henry the Fourth, the line of French rulers runs through kings, emperors and presidents to Emmanuel Macron.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Frans_Pourbus_the_Younger_(Antwerp_1569_-_Paris_1622)_-_Henri_IV,_King_of_France_(1553-1610)_-_RCIN_402972_-_Royal_Collection.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Luis_XIII,_rey_de_Francia_(Philippe_de_Champaigne).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Louis_XIV_of_France.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Louis_XV,_King_of_France_(1710-1774)_edited_2.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Antoine-Fran%C3%A7ois_Callet_-_Louis_XVI,_roi_de_France_et_de_Navarre_(1754-1793),_rev%C3%AAtu_du_grand_costume_royal_en_1779_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jacques-Louis_David_-_The_Emperor_Napoleon_in_His_Study_at_the_Tuileries_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:G%C3%A9rard_-_Louis_XVIII_of_France_in_Coronation_Robes.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1841_portrait_painting_of_Louis_Philippe_I_(King_of_the_French)_by_Winterhalter.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alexandre_Cabanel_002.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Adolphe_Thiers_Nadar_2.JPG + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raymond_Poincar%C3%A9_officiel_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:De_Gaulle-OWI_(cropped)_(c)(2).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Fran%C3%A7ois_Mitterrand_in_1983_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emmanuel_Macron_2025_(cropped).jpg
3. Emmanuel Macron → Vladimir Putin: In 2018, Macron shook hands with Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg.
   Photo by kremlin.ru, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_and_Emmanuel_Macron_(2018-05-24)_07.jpg
4. Vladimir Putin → Barack Obama: Back in 2015, Putin met Barack Obama at the United Nations in New York.
   Photo by Пресс-служба Президента России, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vladimir_Putin_and_Barack_Obama_(2015-09-29)_01.jpg
5. Barack Obama → Adam Savage: In 2010, Obama filmed a MythBusters episode at the White House with Adam Savage.
   Photo by Chuck Kennedy, White House photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Obama_Hyneman_Savage_-_Oct_2010.jpg
6. Adam Savage → Grant Imahara: In 2012, Savage shared a Comic-Con stage with fellow MythBuster Grant Imahara.
   Photo by Genevieve, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jamie_Hyneman,_Grant_Imahara,_Adam_Savage_(7613294308).jpg
7. Grant Imahara → Chris Doohan: In 2013, Imahara posed at Phoenix Comicon with actor Chris, son of the original Star Trek's Scotty.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America, CC BY-SA 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chris_Doohan_%26_Grant_Imahara_(8852930823).jpg
8. Chris Doohan → Todd Haberkorn: In 2015, Chris sat on a Phoenix Comicon panel next to voice actor Todd Haberkorn.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America, CC BY-SA 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Michele_Specht,_Vic_Mignogna,_Chuck_Huber,_Todd_Haberkorn_%26_Chris_Doohan_(18092409509).jpg
9. Todd Haberkorn → Colleen Clinkenbeard: In 2011, Haberkorn signed autographs at New York Comic Con with fellow Fairy Tail voice actor Colleen Clinkenbeard.
   Photo by Nightscream, CC BY 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:10.16.1FairyTailCastByLuigiNovi1.jpg
10. Colleen Clinkenbeard → Luffy: And Clinkenbeard is the English voice of Luffy, the hero of One Piece.
   Photo by John Manard, CC BY-SA 2.0 / Fair use: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Colleen_Clinkenbeard_%26_Luci_Chrisitan_-_One_Piece_QA_-_53140731572.jpg + https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Monkey_D_Luffy.png

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
